brief:
Neera Tanden, a former Biden White House adviser and longtime Hillary Clinton ally, engaged in a televised debate with Mehdi on party strategy and ideology, Zeteo reported. The discussion covered tensions between moderate and progressive wings of the Democratic Party, the midterm elections, and figures including commentator Hasan Piker and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

The clash also addressed the influence of AIPAC, the pro-Israel lobbying group, in Democratic politics. Tanden and Mehdi sparred over approaches to party direction and electoral strategy as internal divisions continue to shape Democratic politics.
dek: The ex-Biden White House adviser, and loyal ally of Hillary Clinton, clashes with Mehdi on ‘moderates’ vs ‘progressives’ in the Democratic Party, the midterms, Hasan Piker, AIPAC, Netanyahu, and more!
title: Tanden and Hasan debate Democratic Party divisions on air
